thread:
nina (People Ops): Quick brainstorm  want to run a pop-up recognition booth at HQ next Friday during lunch. Goal: give on-the-spot micro-spot awards, take quick photos, and hand out stickers/pins. Need logistics + approvals.

sam (Recruiting): Nice! Can Recruiting help staff the table? We can bring swag and a sign-up clip for referrals.

marta (Design): I'll make a 2-sided tabletop sign and a tiny certificate template. Can we order extra enamel pins?

jack (Finance): Budget? If it's a pop-up with ~100 expected folks, estimate per-person cost for swag + snack ~ $6-10. Need final numbers for approval.

alex (Ops): Venue: lobby A or kitchenette C? Lobby A has better foot traffic but needs security sign-off for camera usage.

cj (Eng): I'll volunteer for pics + quick writeups. Do we need photo consent?

nina (People Ops): Yes on consent. We'll have a checkbox on the sign-in tablet and a paper consent for walk-ups. Also want opt-in for public shoutouts.

people-bot: Found last year's event checklist: https://go.example.com/pop-up-checklist. Recommends 3 volunteers, table cloth, power strip, and petty cash float.

marta (Design): Mockups done, posting to #people-ops-assets. Pin color suggestions: teal or navy? teal pops more.

jack (Finance): Approving up to $900 for event line item if headcount <150. If we go >150, need additional approval. Submit estimated spend by Wed.

sam (Recruiting): How will spot awards be decided on the spot? Need simple rubric so it's fair.

nina (People Ops): Proposed rubric: impact in last 30 days, cross-team help, customer impact. Keep it lightweight: 1-2 sentence justification from nominator + manager sign-off on the same day.

cj (Eng): Manager sign-off via DM ok? Might slow things. Could we allow provisional award + manager confirmation email within 48h?

nina (People Ops): Provisional awards ok for physical swag, but final payout requires manager confirmation within 48h. We'll mark those as "pending" in tracker.

alex (Ops): Logistics: need 2 clipboards, tablet for sign-in (iPad), sticky name labels, a small cash float for reimbursements, and heavy-duty envelopes for international shipments if any recipients are remote.

marta (Design): I can print 100 sticker sheets and 120 mini-certificates. Need final counts by Thu EOD.

people-bot: Headcount estimate from desk census for next Friday lunch: 128 onsite.

jack (Finance): Also confirm tax treatment for awards >$600. We should cap immediate award amount at $500 to avoid extra payroll paperwork. Anything >$600 must route through payroll.

sam (Recruiting): We'll staff 2 shifts: 11:30-12:30 and 12:30-1:30. I'll post sign-up in #recruiting.

cj (Eng): I'll handle rapid photo edits and upload to the shared album. Will everyone be opt-in?

nina (People Ops): Yes opt-in only. We'll collect consent at sign-in. For remote winners, we'll mail a kit + digital certificate. Confirm contractors: contractors >90 days eligible, but payments handled differently (no taxable payroll; use vendor/incidental card). People Ops will review list.

jack (Finance): For contractors receiving physical swag only, no payment needed. If we issue monetary awards to contractors, coordinate with legal/payroll.

alex (Ops): I'll reserve Lobby A and request security coverage. Also ordering a 6-ft folding table and tablecloth. Delivery scheduled Fri morning.

marta (Design): Final artwork uploaded. Also made a small "how to nominate" one-pager for volunteers.

nina (People Ops): Action items: 1) Alex reserve space + table (by Mon). 2) Marta finalize prints + pin order (by Thu). 3) Jack confirm budget lines and cap (done). 4) People Ops to prep tablet form and consent text (by Thu). 5) Recruiting to staff shifts (Sam). 6) CJ to manage photos. 7) people-bot to export list of contractors for eligibility check.

people-bot: Export complete: 9 contractors on campus next Friday; 6 meet >90 days eligibility. Link: https://go.example.com/contractor-export

sam (Recruiting): Putting volunteer sign-up on calendar now.

alex (Ops): Security asked for a one-page event brief. I'll draft and post here for review.

nina (People Ops): Great. Let's keep this low-friction and celebratory. If anyone has creative mini-activities (2-3 minute), drop ideas here. Maybe a "gratitude mic" where people can say quick thanks on camera.

cj (Eng): love the mic idea. Keep it casual.

marta (Design): I'll make a tiny "we ❤️ you" backdrop for photos.

nina (People Ops): Closing thread for now  I'll post final checklist Wed AM and confirm vendors. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
